incidents.name: CFC pair-balance skim
incidents.notes: CFC's transfer path removes tokens from the liquidity pair's own balance without a sync(), so the attacker repeatedly skim()ed the surplus and swapped it out for the pair's USDT.

sources.ref: onchain review: CFC 0xdd9b223aec6ea56567a62f21ff89585ff125632c created 2023-05-29T13:12:14Z by 0x7c0cddc5aa0c835dd7f27781b81a59dec05f4fc3, unrelated to attack sender 0x106016cdc3878c7ff2b386303000db0001d838eb; no EIP-1967 Upgraded events, age measured from deployment. This transaction moved 6,124.40 USDT to the attack contract 0x8213e87bb381919b292ace364d97d3a1ee38caa4; lossUsd uses the ~$16k reported across the two attack transactions.
